verdict.rationale: Luma ships an API with docs at docs.lumalabs.ai, Python/JS/TS SDKs, an llms.txt and markdown versions of doc pages. None of the evidence shows an interactive API reference, a try-it console, or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Machine-readable docs and SDKs are adjacent features, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.
